lines.hook: The world your parents knew... is gone. The way people work, earn, and make an impact — it's changing completely. And the new world has a language: English. And a tool: artificial intelligence. But here is the real question: what will YOU build with it?
lines.cover: Right now, somewhere, one person — alone — is building something the whole world will use. No company. No permission. Just an idea, and the right tools. This year... that person is you.
lines.demo-harish: A broken streetlight on Kalanit Street. You snap a photo. The A.I. knows what it is, where it is, how urgent it is. The city sees it on a live map. The neighbor gets one word back: fixed. That is a product. And someone pays for it.
lines.demo-business: A pizzeria in Harish. Orders flying in on WhatsApp. A bot your team built reads every order, confirms it, sends it to the kitchen. One hundred and forty-nine shekels a month. Ten shops... and it never sleeps.
lines.demo-jewish: A mother just gave birth. She needs meals. The A.I. writes the request, translates it to Hebrew, English, Russian — because Harish is a city of immigrants. It finds the volunteers. Love your neighbor... powered by software.
lines.close: I came thirteen thousand kilometers to stand in this room. The only difference between you and me... is that I already started. Today, you start. Ready to build your world?
